title: Steak Guide

ingredientGroups.title: Ingredients
items: Clarified butter or beef tallow, for brushing

steps: Sear steaks at the highest temperature possible for 4 minutes, flipping and rotating 90° every 30 seconds.
Finish in the oven, flipping every 2 minutes. The source suggests no oven time for rare, 2 minutes for medium-rare, 4 minutes for medium, 6 minutes for medium-well and 8 minutes for well-done.
Rest for 10 minutes, brush with clarified butter or beef tallow and serve.
